lines.1: 「I bought her a Ceylon tea, so we've already met. I've got this in the bag.」
lines.2: 「There's nothing wrong with a romance that starts at 400 yen.」
lines.3: 「All right, you guys wait here. Even if we get as far as kissing, you can only stand there and watch jealously.」
lines.4: 「What kind of math gets you all the way to a kiss?」
lines.5: 「I'm finally gonna have a girlfriend. Hey, Crab, take a picture of my face when I get back. The face of a man who's accomplished a great deed.」
